items.instrument: Rigaku UItimate IV X-ray diffractometer with Cu Ka radiation
items.quote: The constituent phases of alloys were analyzed by Rigaku UItimate IV X-ray diffractometer with Cu Ka radiation.
The accuracy of temperature measurements using 80PK-1 K-type thermocouple (temperature measuring instrument: Fluke 53IIB) was estimated to be ±1   C.

items.calibration: The pure element Mn and simple compound SiO2 were used as standards.
items.instrument: AJSM-6360LV scanning electron microscope (SEM) equipped with Oxford Instruments energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS)
items.quote: Microstructures of the selected alloys were determined with AJSM-6360LV scanning electron microscope (SEM) equipped with Oxford Instruments energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS). The pure element Mn and simple compound SiO2 were used as standards.

items.applies_to: The alloys of the LieSieMn ternary system
items.atmosphere_or_container: special adapted tantalum containers in evacuated quartz ampoules
items.quote: The alloys of the LieSieMn ternary system were annealed at 150   C for 960 h in special adapted tantalum containers in evacuated quartz ampoules and quenched in cold water.
